title: docs: TROUBLESHOOTING.md prescribes a moe.update_settings tool that does not exist, a reinstall block whose install-all.ps1 call installs no plugin, copying worktree edits into the project root although worktree mode lands from the worktree, and a Tools > Moe > Initialize Project item that is named Initialize Moe
description:
Filed by defect hunt #7 (task-44785c82, architect-1dd28c7c). Checked against moe/work-2026-10-24 22348856; detector outputs are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-44785c82/B/. Docs-only: edit docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and nothing else.

ITEMS (doc line, then the code or doc line that contradicts it), worst first:
1. :936-937 says "Apply via `moe.update_settings` / `scripts/moe-call.sh`, never by hand-editing `.moe/`".
   - No moe.update_settings tool exists: `git show moe/work-2026-10-24:packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts | grep -c update_settings` prints 0.
   - The only settings route is the plugin's /ws UPDATE_SETTINGS, as the same doc says at :1231.
2. :631-635, the "rebuild and reinstall" block: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build`, then `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew buildPlugin`, then `.\scripts\install-all.ps1`.
   - install-all.ps1 installs the plugin only with -InstallPlugin (scripts/install-all.ps1:116 `if ($InstallPlugin) { Install-JetBrainsPlugin }`; :142 says "re-run with -BuildPlugin").
   - The second cd is relative to packages/moe-daemon, so it fails.
   - The block never builds moe-proxy, which buildPlugin requires (moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts:129-131).
   - The same doc's working form is at :119 and :442: `.\scripts\install-all.ps1 -BuildPlugin -InstallPlugin -IdeVersion <IDE folder>`.
3. :554-556 says "edited inside a `.worktrees/` checkout the post-flight cannot see … Move the edits into the project root". :667-668 says "invisible to the post-flight, which only ever runs against the project root. Copy them into the root".
   - In worktree mode the wrapper lands from the task worktree. scripts/CLAUDE.md:13 says a worker "works in, and lands from, its own task worktree", and scripts/moe-agent.sh:7291-7292 takes MOE_WT_PATH as the landing top. The same doc says so at :1226-1227.
   - This repo runs worktree mode, so copying the edits into the control checkout is harmful advice. Scope both passages to shared mode.
4. :103 and :220 say "Tools > Moe > Initialize Project".
   - The action is "Initialize Moe": moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/META-INF/plugin.xml:85 has `text="Initialize Moe"`, and DEVELOPMENT.md:55 already has it right.
   - :104 "Or manually create .moe/project.json" contradicts the never-hand-edit rule. Point to `node packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js init --project <path>`.
5. :341-343 quotes the error "Worker not registered". No code emits it: 0 hits in packages, scripts, moe-jetbrains/src and moe-vscode/src. The real refusal is chatJoin.ts:31 `Unknown worker: workerId must be a registered worker, "human", or "system"`.
6. :168 says `# Shows: { "port": 3141, ... }`. The default is 9876: packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:43 reads `MOE_DEFAULT_PORT || '9876'`, and the daemon auto-scans the next 50 ports.
definitionOfDone: `grep 'install-all.ps1' docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md | grep -vc -- '-InstallPlugin'` prints 0. The :631-635 reinstall block is that one install-all.ps1 command, or it builds moe-proxy before buildPlugin.

`grep -c 'only ever runs against the project root' docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` prints 0, and both .worktrees passages say what applies in worktree mode. `git diff --name-only` against the merge base lists only docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md.

implementationPlan.description:
EDIT docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md only, with the Edit tool (project rail: no shell writes into the tree). Make the 8 exact replacements below. Each old string occurs exactly once at c99801aa. Applied to a scratch copy, they turned step 2's gate green. Keep every other line and section untouched. Two doc tests read other sections of this file: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts (the NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT heading, and the phrases 'then a self-land' / 'landed the row itself' must stay absent) and scripts/tests/account-trust-docs.test.mjs (## Claude Account Rotation Issues). No anchor links into the edited headings (`grep -rhoE 'TROUBLESHOOTING\.md#[a-z0-9-]+'`).

R1, item 4 (:103-104). Old:
# From JetBrains plugin: Tools > Moe > Initialize Project
# Or manually create .moe/project.json
New:
# From the JetBrains plugin: Tools > Moe > Initialize Moe
# Or from a terminal (creates .moe/ and starts the daemon; never hand-write .moe/project.json):
node packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js init --project <path>
Fact: plugin.xml:85 text="Initialize Moe"; DEVELOPMENT.md:55 already says Tools → Moe → Initialize Moe.

R2, item 6 (:168). Old: # Shows: { "port": 3141, ... }
New: # Shows: { "port": 9876, ... }  (9876 is the default; a taken port moves to the next free one, up to 50 higher)
Fact: packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:43-44, MOE_DEFAULT_PORT || '9876' and MOE_PORT_RANGE || '50'.

R3, item 4 (:220). Old: **Solution:** Initialize via Tools > Moe > Initialize Project
New: **Solution:** Initialize via Tools > Moe > Initialize Moe

R4, item 5 (:341-343). Old:
#### "Worker not registered"

**Solution:** Register the worker first using `moe.claim_next_task`.
New:
#### `Unknown worker: workerId must be a registered worker, "human", or "system"`

**Solution:** `moe.chat_join` refuses a `workerId` that has no worker record. Register the seat first:
`moe.claim_next_task` or `moe.join_team` creates the record (`moe.enter_governance` for a governor), and the
agent wrappers do both in pre-flight. A daemon restart purges worker records that are neither recently active
nor mid-execution, so re-register after one.
Fact: chatJoin.ts:31 is the only emitter; worker records are created in claimNextTask.ts:800, joinTeam.ts:72 and enterGovernance.ts.

R5, item 2 (:631-635). Replace the whole fenced block (```bash plus its 3 lines: cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build ..., cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew buildPlugin, .\scripts\install-all.ps1 ... # then restart the IDE) with:
```powershell
# Builds the daemon, the proxy and the plugin, then installs the plugin. Restart the IDE afterwards.
.\scripts\install-all.ps1 -BuildPlugin -InstallPlugin -IdeVersion <IDE folder>
```
Fact: install-all.ps1 runs Install-NodePackage (npm install, then build) for moe-daemon and moe-proxy, and installs the plugin only under -InstallPlugin (:116). This is the same form as the doc's own :119 and :442. Keep the surrounding Note sentence.

R6, item 3a (:555-556, the MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_OWNED_PATH_MISSING bullet; keep its first line). Old:
  absent from disk and from HEAD (renamed, deleted, or edited inside a `.worktrees/` checkout the
  post-flight cannot see). Move the edits into the project root and re-declare.
New:
  absent from disk and from HEAD of the checkout the post-flight lands from (renamed, deleted, or edited
  in another checkout). In shared mode that is the project root: move edits made inside a `.worktrees/`
  checkout into the root and re-declare. In worktree mode a worker lands from its own task worktree
  `.worktrees/<taskId>`: move edits made in the control checkout or in another task's worktree into that
  task worktree and re-declare, never into the control checkout.

R7, item 3b (:667-668). Old:
4. The edits were made inside a `.worktrees/` checkout — invisible to the post-flight, which only ever
   runs against the project root. Copy them into the root and `moe.declare_files` them.
New:
4. The edits were made in a checkout the post-flight does not land from. In shared mode it lands from
   the project root, so edits inside a `.worktrees/` checkout are invisible: copy them into the root and
   `moe.declare_files` them. In worktree mode a worker lands from its own task worktree
   `.worktrees/<taskId>`: move edits made in the control checkout or another worktree into that task
   worktree and declare them there, never into the control checkout.
Fact for R6/R7: scripts/CLAUDE.md, 'Land on every exit, worktree mode': a worker "works in, and lands from, its own task worktree W"; this doc's :1226-1227 says the same. The row's moe-agent.sh:7291 cite is the VM landing path; do not cite it.

R8, item 1 (:936-937). Old:
the fields live, rewrite the rails. Apply via `moe.update_settings` / `scripts/moe-call.sh`, never by
hand-editing `.moe/`:
New:
the fields live, rewrite the rails. Apply each rail edit as a `moe.propose_rail` proposal
(`targetScope: "GLOBAL"`, `MODIFY_RAIL` / `REMOVE_RAIL` / `ADD_RAIL`; from an agent seat or
`scripts/moe-call.sh`) that a human approves on the board, and any settings change through the plugin
(`UPDATE_SETTINGS`), never by hand-editing `.moe/`:
Fact: tools/index.ts has no update_settings (0 hits). customRules change only through StateManager.applyRailChange (targetScope GLOBAL) when a proposal is approved (the plugin's APPROVE_PROPOSAL, MoeCommandSender.kt:382). /ws UPDATE_SETTINGS (WebSocketServer.ts:828) only writes settings.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW (load the adversarial-self-review skill) of this one-file diff:
- Is every new claim true at HEAD? Re-check the facts cited in step 1: plugin.xml:85, index.ts:43-44, chatJoin.ts:31 and its registration paths, install-all.ps1 :116 and Install-NodePackage, scripts/CLAUDE.md's worktree-mode landing rule, propose_rail's schema (proposalType and targetScope enums) and WebSocketServer.ts:828.
- Did any rewrite drift into new advice the code does not support?
- Do the shared-mode instructions still hold?
- Is the never-hand-edit-.moe rule kept everywhere you touched?
- Do markdown fences still balance (the R5 fence changed from bash to powershell)? Does the R4 heading with inner quotes render?
- `git diff --stat` shows one file, and no added line contains a project.json globalRails.forbiddenPatterns string.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md stops prescribing things that do not exist or are wrong. Rail edits go through moe.propose_rail GLOBAL proposals that a human approves, never a moe.update_settings tool. The reinstall block is the one install-all.ps1 -BuildPlugin -InstallPlugin command. Both .worktrees passages are scoped to shared mode and say a worktree-mode worker lands from its own task worktree. The init action is Tools > Moe > Initialize Moe, or `init --project`. The real chat_join refusal is quoted, and the default port is 9876. No other file changes.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Two edit steps (top-of-file fixes, then landing passages) would push the plan to 4 steps and the standard tier for a one-file docs change, so all eight replacements sit in one step. Keeping the original three-command reinstall block with a moe-proxy build added (DoD 2's other option) was rejected: it duplicates what install-all.ps1 -BuildPlugin -InstallPlugin already does, and :119/:442 use that one command.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: DoD 3's raw grep already passes at HEAD, because the phrase wraps across :667-668. The gate joins lines and also positively checks that both passages mention worktree mode. Applied to a scratch copy, the replacement text gave dod1=0 dod2=0 dod3=0 wt=1,1. The role-doc linter (npm run lint, the landing qualityGate) covers only docs/roles, so this file cannot trip it.
planningNotes.risks: - In the control checkout `git diff --name-only <merge-base>` lists the uncommitted .moe board diffs. QA should use `git show --name-only` on the completion commit instead (step 2). - R4's heading uses backticks around a message that contains double quotes. Keep the exact message text from chatJoin.ts:31. - Do not edit the NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT or Claude Account Rotation sections (doc tests read them).
